title: Console: Telemetry Sampling & Export Sequencer Playbook for Enterprise Requests
creator: Lena Park
description:
Summary: Enterprise customers frequently request large, high-frequency usage and cost exports from the Console for downstream analytics and chargeback. These ad-hoc exports (multi-GB CSV/Parquet) create burst load on the telemetry pipeline and storage, cause uneven query latency for live dashboards, and increase billable egress and compute costs. This ticket defines a playbook and a lightweight orchestration layer — the Export Sequencer — coupled with telemetry sampling strategies to safely surface requested data to customers while protecting platform SLAs and unit economics.

Scope:
- Design an export orchestration pattern (Export Sequencer) to queue, schedule, and rate-limit large exports per workspace/SLA tier.
- Define telemetry sampling policies (time-decimation, tiered sampling windows, and event-level sampling) so exports and live dashboards can coexist.
- Add product-level gating: quota check, tenant cost-estimate, approval flag for exports over threshold, and recommended export formats.
- UX: console flow that previews estimated compute/egress cost and expected completion window.

Out of scope: deep data-model changes to telemetry schema, ad-hoc per-customer ETL integrations, migration of legacy exports to new format (handled separately).

Goals:
1) Reduce live dashboard latency regressions caused by export jobs by 70% for affected queries.
2) Keep incremental cost overhead of sampling < 10% for P0 customers.
3) Provide clear cost & SLA messaging in Console and a self-serve approval path for large exports.
acceptance_criteria: Sequencer prototype implemented: queuing, per-tenant concurrency limit, retry/backoff, and cancellation support established
Telemetry sampling policies configurable per-tenant and per-export-template in Console
Console export flow shows cost estimate and expected completion window before submit
Export jobs respect workspace quota/commit tiers and fail fast with actionable messaging when over quota
Metric: 70% reduction in p95 query-time variance on live dashboards during heavy export activity in staging cluster
Integration tests for export correctness across CSV/Parquet and for sampled vs full exports
Runbook updated and an on-call mitigation path documented for stuck exports or pipeline backpressure
decisions: Prefer sequenced, scheduled exports (queued background jobs) over synchronous streaming for >100k rows
Default sampling policy: 'recent-dense + long-tail-sparse' blend (dense 1h window at 100% followed by exponentially decaying sampling)
Expose a conservative cost estimate rather than exact billing to prevent surprise charges; link to detailed billing export for reconciliation
Use existing telemetry storage (S3/GCS) and Bolt worker pool for orchestration; do not add a new DB for queueing in this phase
Provide two export classes in v1: fast (small, immediate), bulk (queued, scheduled with estimate)
Authorization: exports inherit workspace RBAC; administrators can enable manual approvals for bulk exports
tasks: PM: finalize export size thresholds and pricing/quota bands with Finance and Growth
Eng: implement sequencer API + worker (queueing, concurrency controls, TTL, cancel)
Eng: add telemetry sampling config and apply sampling at read-time for export queries
Console: wire cost/ETA preview and approval flow into export modal
Eng/Infra: create staging load test harness to reproduce dashboard/export contention scenarios
SRE: define runbook and automated throttling hook for export-induced backpressure
Docs: write admin guide for bulk exports and recommended export templates/formatting

comments: 2025-02-12 - Lena Park: Kicked off cross-functional discovery. Spoke with 3 enterprise customers (payments, adtech, analytics) — common ask: daily full-usage dump + hourly deltas. Pain point: lack of cost visibility and export scheduling.

2025-02-18 - Marcus Hsu: Eng spike completed. Sequencer prototype (in-memory queue + Bolt worker) can support per-tenant concurrency but needs persistence for restart resilience — recommending Redis streams as a lightweight durable queue.
2025-02-24 - Finance (J. Ortiz): Recommended conservative cost brackets and a per-GB egress estimate to surface in the UI; flagged need for billing team sign-off before GA.

2025-03-01 - Design review (I. Nguyen): Console modal mockups reviewed; asked to include 'estimated completion window' and an inline explain link for sampling implications to avoid confusion when customers receive sampled exports.
2025-03-03 - SRE: Added staging load test plan. Early runs show p95 dashboard queries spike when 3 concurrent bulk exports run against the same tenant — will iterate throttling strategy.

2025-03-05 - Next: schedule alignment meeting with Billing + Security to validate estimate math and confirm no additional compliance gating required. Action: Marcus to open ENG task for Redis streams proof-of-concept.
